components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact filled action for the main task in a section.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid #E83E8C; border-radius: 7px; background: #E83E8C; color: #fff; font: 500 0.8rem/1.4 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #D63384; border-color: #D63384; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E83E8C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Main-surface search field with a quiet border and pink focus treatment.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="Search listings" aria-label="Search listings">
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; padding: 0.55rem 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #E4E7EC; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #101828; font: 400 0.875rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color: #D0D5DD; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(232,62,140,0.22); border-color: #E83E8C; }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Quiet horizontal route navigation with a pink underline for the current view.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Main navigation"><button class="ds-nav-tab">Brief</button><button class="ds-nav-tab is-active" aria-current="page">Active</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 0.25rem; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #E4E7EC; } .ds-nav-tab { padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; background: transparent; color: #667085; font: 500 0.85rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: #344054; } .ds-nav-tab.is-active { border-bottom-color: #E83E8C; color: #101828; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E83E8C; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped filter or active state in the default pink theme.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { padding: 0.22rem 0.45rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #FDECF4; color: #7A1745; font: 500 0.7rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-filter-chip:hover, .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #F9D0E2; color: #7A1745; } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E83E8C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Property Card
components.description: White listing surface with compact facts and restrained elevation.
components.css: .ds-property-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr; gap: 0.875rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.55rem 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #E4E7EC; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #101828; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(16,24,40,0.06); font: 400 0.8rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-property-card:hover { border-color: #C8D3E6; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(16,24,40,0.10); } .ds-property-card__photo { min-height: 64px; border-radius: 8px; background: #F2F4F7; } .ds-property-card p { margin-top: 0.25rem; color: #667085; font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Score Badge
components.description: Pill badge that communicates a listing score state with text and color.
components.css: .ds-score-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 2rem; padding: 0.18rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #027A48; color: #fff; font: 700 0.7rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Immowbot's interface is a compact, practical workspace for managing a property search. A dark burgundy configuration rail holds search criteria and collection controls beside a light, neutral work area for reviewing listings. DM Sans and small, consistent labels keep the dense information legible; vivid pink marks the active path and primary actions.

The overall feel is calm and reassuring, without the stiffness of a generic corporate dashboard. Listing photographs and information remain the focus. The optional Vlaams theme uses near-black surfaces with Flemish gold accents while preserving the same layout and interaction patterns.
keyCharacteristics: Dark burgundy controls alongside a light neutral canvas
Vivid pink accents in the default theme; black and Flemish gold in the optional theme
Mostly flat surfaces, with restrained elevation for cards and overlays
dos: Do keep listing information easy to scan in compact, repeated rows.
Do use vivid pink for primary and active states in the default theme.
Do preserve clear contrast between the burgundy configuration rail and the neutral work surface.
Do use score colors consistently: green for positive, amber for caution, red for negative.
Do let property photography and listing facts carry the visual weight.
donts: Don't replace the established DM Sans family with an unrelated display face without a deliberate system change.
Don't use the pink accent as a substitute for score or alert state colors.
Don't add heavy shadows to routine controls and content cards; depth is restrained in the current interface.
Don't turn the dense buyer workspace into a generic marketing dashboard; preserve its practical command-desk character.
